items.title: HRTech-AI-Hiring-01
items.description: 63-repo HRTech codebase from a GPT-4 powered recruitment platform. Covers ATS (BE+FE), candidate sourcing, AI interview bot, video proctoring, email/forms/campaign microservices, and FastHQ admin/client suites. Node.js + Python polyglot, GitHub Actions CI on 35/63 repos. 2,163 PRs signal an actively-managed multi-team product org. Traction: India-based AI recruitment SaaS, founded 2022. Seed round from 14+ angel investors across consumer internet, fintech and media. GPT-4 powered AI interview & talent screening platform.

items.title: B2B-ITMonitoring-AI-01
items.description:
168-repo enterprise AIOps platform built for real-time anomaly detection across metrics and logs, with automated root cause analysis and microservices orchestration. Go-heavy backend with Python ML stack and C++ inference. 2,000+ PRs on the core repo - highest engineering-signal density in the corpus. Traction: Raised $2.34M (€2.1M) from Aster Capital, BNP Paribas Developpement, Entrepreneur First, and SGPA. 
Paris-based; 5 years of prior R&D in French & Canadian labs. 
Enterprise B2B product — reduces IT incident costs by up to 70%, cuts MTTR by 40%. Won Startup Numérique Trophy 2018. 
Early enterprise customers at launch; positioned against Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace.

items.title: EdTech-Platform-01
items.description: 35-repo codebase from one of India's largest online vocational education platforms, spanning 8 years of continuous development. Covers LMS, CRM, student dashboards, microservices (content, orders, enrollment, coupons), and admin tooling. PHP/Python/JS/TypeScript polyglot, one of the deepest multi-year EdTech codebases in the corpus. Traction: Co raised $13.4M total; 22,000 enrolled students across 66 countries; acquired. Combined AEON entity: ~₹13.65 Cr (USD 1.5M) revenue in FY17, targeting ₹30 Cr in FY18.(USD 4M)

items.title: PreviewVR
items.description: PreviewVR is a small Unity VR application for previewing content in a headset. It uses the XR Plugin and XR Interaction Toolkit with input-action-driven rig controls and grip-based teleport locomotion, plus a 'present' mode. It is a minimal utility (6 commits).

items.title: M10A-reader
items.description: M10A-reader is a small C# console utility that reads and OCRs 'M10A' cards. It uses AForge for image handling and IronOCR (with the German language pack) to extract text from card images. The repository is a minimal tool (4 commits).

items.title: KyntheumAR
items.description: KyntheumAR is a Unity augmented-reality application (for the 'Kyntheum' brand) built around image tracking. Its scripts (ImageTrackerController, SelectionController, Item) drive marker/image-based AR with selectable items. The repository is a minimal single-commit project (mostly Unity assets/settings).

items.title: SETools
items.description: SETools is 's internal web toolkit/framework — a set of shared .NET libraries (WebClient, WebServer, WebShared, Shared) used as the common foundation across the company's ASP.NET Core/Blazor projects (referenced by eventure-server, eventure-dash and others). It provides JWT/Identity-based authentication management, ASP integration/app-builder helpers, a type-conversion utility and Swagger annotations.

items.title: Eventerspace-Pen-Grounds
items.description: Eventerspace-Pen-Grounds is a small Node.js load-testing toolkit for the eventerspace platform. It launches many headless-browser 'puppets' (Puppeteer) that each log in with credentials served by a local 'puppet-master' Express server (from users.json), simulating concurrent user load. A separate 'droplet-manager' automates provisioning of DigitalOcean droplets running the puppet/puppet-master Docker images to scale the test, parameterized by SSH key, bot count and host.

items.title: audioRecBackend
items.description: audioRecBackend is a small Node.js/Express (TypeScript) backend for audio recording and mixing. It exposes endpoints to create/delete recording sessions, upload audio files, list session files, and process/mix them server-side by shelling out to ffmpeg. A minimal Bootstrap HTML page ('Audio Mix') provides a test UI.

items.title: ToolOneMobile
items.description: ToolOneMobile is a cross-platform React Native (TypeScript) mobile client scaffold for the 'ToolOne' work/time-tracking product, targeting Android, iOS and Windows (react-native-windows). It is built offline-first around WatermelonDB and includes work-item overview/detail and about screens with stack navigation. The repository is an early template setup (single commit).

items.title: VRBlood
items.description: VRBlood is a small Unity VR interaction demo. Its scripts implement room-tile-based teleport/locomotion (RoomTileManager), ray-cast interaction (InteractRayCaster) and a radial interact menu (InteractMenuController). It is a single-commit, minimal project (an early prototype for a VR experience).

items.title: heynote-android
items.description: heynote-android is the native Android (Java) client of the Heynote SaaS — a thin native shell that hosts the Heynote web app in a WebView and adds native capabilities: speech recognition (with permission handling), scheduled notifications, JWT token-refresh handling across the WebView lifecycle (onPause/onResume), and a hardened network-security configuration. It is actively versioned for the Play Store.

items.title: eventure-release-packer
items.description: eventure-release-packer is a Windows Forms (C#) desktop utility used to package and upload Eventure releases. It builds the correct folder structure into a zip, lets the user select a release and fetch a branch via dropdown/context menus, watches files, surfaces console messages (focusing the console on errors), and uploads the result. It is internal build/release tooling.

items.title: audioRecVR
items.description: audioRecVR is a minimal Unity VR front-end companion to audioRecBackend — a VR scene for audio recording. It is a single-commit, early project (mostly Unity scaffolding and a few scripts/shaders).

items.title: cosentyx
items.description: cosentyx is a Unity interactive medical visualization (WebGL) for the Cosentyx pharmaceutical brand. It presents an animated 3D spine/vertebrae model illustrating inflammation: synchronized camera motion that follows the animation, zoomable annotations (lines that track and scale with zoom), multi-language labels, hover-driven emission highlighting, inflamed-vertebra masks/materials and a navigation panel. It runs embedded in HTML and saw real iterative development (62 commits).

items.title: propertyvr
items.description: propertyvr is a Unity VR project for property/real-estate visualization. The committed code is largely an asset-store mesh-combiner utility (Easy Mesh Combiner) plus project scaffolding; it is a minimal, single-commit project.

items.title: DocHollidayServer
items.description: DocHollidayServer is a multi-tenant medical-practice management application built on ASP.NET Core + Blazor WebAssembly, with a companion .NET MAUI app. Each user belongs to a 'Practice' (tenant) enforced via a global EF query filter. It models Employees and Patients with type-specific registration, provides QR/barcode scanning (extracted into a Razor class library), Apple push notifications (CorePush), and lazy-loaded practice modules. It is derived from the ToolOneServer template (bulk-renamed).

items.title: pimero-tools
items.description: pimero-tools is a C# utility suite for the Pimero software ecosystem. Its main tool, Publisher, manages software releases (compilation/version management, Inno Setup installer creation, FTP upload, archive management, code signing, mobile-component version comparison). Companion tools parse Pimero session files (SessionParse) and read/analyze logs (XmlLogReader/GoogleLogReader, LogReader, LogDeflator). One commit, imported alongside the pimero migration.

items.title: LiquiMolly
items.description: LiquiMolly is an ASP.NET Core + Blazor WebAssembly multi-tenant application scaffold for the Liqui Moly (automotive lubricants) brand, created from 's ToolOneServer/MudBlazor template. It carries the same multi-tenant ('Contractor') architecture, MudBlazor UI, MySQL EF Core + Dapper data layer and email service, but contains only initial scaffolding (2 commits).

items.title: SchwabeUWPApp
items.description: SchwabeUWPApp is a Windows (UWP) desktop application built for Schwabe (pharmaceuticals), used as a sales/detailing and content-presentation tool. It centres on a PDF viewer (fullscreen, custom zoom, language-aware overlays, always-visible scrollbar) plus management of products and medical indications, 'Mode of Action' content, offline login, and email sending. Content and models are synced from a backend REST API. Notably it has a real pull-request workflow (12 merged PRs), uncommon in this portfolio.

items.title: ContainerVessel
items.description: ContainerVessel is a Unity 3D visualization of a container ship/maritime vessel, featuring a real-time ocean/sea-surface renderer (BestOcean) and volumetric clouds (CloudsToy). It is a small, single-commit project; most content is asset-store packages plus ~71 C# scripts.

items.title: UnityPackage
items.description: UnityPackage is a reusable internal Unity package/toolkit by  (the 'Softevo' namespace). It bundles common building blocks — helper utilities (e.g. MoveWith), an entity/combat system (projectiles, weapons), interactables, sound-on-collision, menus and a playground sample scene — for reuse across the company's Unity projects.

items.title: ToolOneServer
items.description: ToolOneServer is a multi-tenant time-tracking and project-management platform built on ASP.NET Core with a Blazor WebAssembly client and a companion .NET MAUI cross-platform app. Each user belongs to a 'Contractor' (tenant) whose id is stored in the auth claims and applied as a global EF query filter, guaranteeing tenant isolation. It supports Blazor pre-rendering, cookie+JWT auth, project detail pages and manual time entry, with a MudBlazor UI. This template/architecture is later reused by DocHollidayServer and LiquiMolly.

items.title: OrderAssistantiOS
items.description: OrderAssistantiOS is the native iOS app (Objective-C, internal Xcode project 'Heartbeat') for 's Order Assistant / field-CRM product. Employees manage customers and a per-customer activity timeline (notes, bullets, customer-context bubbles), with time tracking (start/stop tied to an owner id, editable TimeTracks and Notes) and a map showing the customer's location. It is the iOS counterpart to OrderAssistantFrontend.

items.title: Qlick-2023
items.description: Qlick-2023 is the rebuilt second generation of the Qlick business application: a .NET backend with an upgraded Angular 16 frontend (DevExtreme), Excel export (ExcelJS), relative configuration, local DB config and a debug page. It uses Active Directory access and is delivered as periodic release builds.

items.title: Qlick
items.description: Qlick is a business web application combining a .NET backend with an Angular frontend (DevExtreme UI components) and Active Directory access (TestADAccess). It is delivered as periodic release builds. This is the first-generation client, later superseded by Qlick-2023.

items.title: -SPMPromoAppUpdated
items.description: -SPMPromoAppUpdated is a Unity promotional application notable for a high-quality real-time ocean/sea-surface renderer (a SIGGRAPH-2017-inspired water shader) together with a Modern UI Pack and volumetric cloud effects. The committed content is predominantly asset-store packages; it is a single-commit promo build.

items.title: GeniusHeartbeat
items.description: GeniusHeartbeat is a native iOS app (Objective-C, Xcode project 'Heartbeat'/'Genius') for AI-assisted social-media content creation. Users record video with a teleprompter (adjustable colour, on-screen prompt and record button), receive AI recommendations and a generated social-media post list, and the app stitches videos together. It authenticates via Auth0 (WKWebView), parses HTML content, caches topics, and supports sharing.

items.title: SchoolCovid
items.description: SchoolCovid is a PHP web application for managing COVID-19 testing in schools. It handles school/class management, pupil-to-tube assignment ('falcon codes'), CSV import of pupils, integration with a lab sample-tracker API (with IP whitelisting and internationalized phone numbers), pooled-test result handling with parent notifications (including when a different pool tests positive), school logins with password validation, and imprint/privacy pages.

items.title: heynote-mobile
items.description: heynote-mobile is the employee-facing mobile web app (PWA) of the Heynote SaaS. Field employees use it to record their work: running timers with totals, customer management, an activity 'feed' of entries (information, work images, time tracks), date-placeholder text, QR scanning and map/location features. It is a Vue 3 single-page app that talks to the Heynote API through a generated OpenAPI client and mirrors the native iOS app's behaviour.

items.title: Rainbow
items.description: Rainbow is a Unity-based mobile/AR application combining location-based AR (AR+GPS, Mapbox routes) with devotional content (weekly verse 'Wochenspruch', prayer lists) and a runtime 'World Builder' that lets users place and persist objects in a scene. It features Firebase push notifications, DE/EN localization, native gallery/share integration, an intro animation and custom shaders. It is long-lived (2019-2025).

items.title: VNSScenes
items.description: VNSScenes holds the Unity scenes/levels for the VNS virtual event spaces — demo expo worlds and client-specific halls (Automotive, Spengler, T-Systems Suppliers Day, SVC). It manages scene-change interactables, world-builder user functions, spawn points, asset-bundle integration and play-mode safeguards. Sustained, multi-author content work (164 commits, 8 contributors).

items.title: MakerMeter
items.description: MakerMeter is a multi-tenant business application built on the ABP Framework, pairing an ASP.NET Core backend with an Angular frontend. It manages customers and projects with project images stored in blob storage, plus filtered project listing. ABP provides identity, tenant management, settings and account modules out of the box. Its 27 'test' files are largely ABP template scaffolding.

items.title: heynote-ios
items.description: heynote-ios is the native iOS app (Objective-C, shared 'Heartbeat/Genius' app shell) of the Heynote SaaS — the full-featured employee client. It provides time tracking (start/stop/pause synced to the server), a customer activity feed that re-sorts live, live chat, camera capture, registration with field validation and terms confirmation, team-member management (add members, assign/revoke licenses, deactivate), trial-end handling, password-reset and email-confirmation flows.

items.title: MaglifyReader6Android
items.description: MaglifyReader6Android is the native Android (Java) reader app of the 'Maglify' digital-magazine family (version 6). It downloads and displays digital magazines, integrates the CraftAR image-recognition/AR SDK for scanning printed pages, manages content/downloads, supports publisher flavours (e.g. VDZ) and consent management (Sourcepoint), and targets Play Store compatibility.

items.title: OrderAssistantFrontend
items.description: OrderAssistantFrontend is a Vue 3 single-page frontend for an 'Order Assistant' business application (internal codename 'Prolet'/'NM'). It provides authenticated order and customer workflows: a search box that auto-applies after a short delay, customer selection/linking, sidebar navigation, Google sign-in/sign-up, theming with a working dark-mode toggle and OS-preferred colour scheme, and charts. It is based on the PrimeVue 'Sakai' admin template.

items.title: MaglifyReader5-iOS
items.description: MaglifyReader5-iOS is the version-5 native iOS magazine reader in the Maglify family. It adds publisher flavours (Pegel eDocs, RSS Feed), dark mode across views, SourcePoint consent (including on the 'shelf'), Catchoom/Scanarius scanning and updated tracking. It shares the MaglifyReaderHD Objective-C codebase with v4.

items.title: MaglifyReader4HD
items.description: MaglifyReader4HD is a native iOS magazine-reader app (Objective-C) in the Maglify family ('Reader HD'). It supports in-app content purchase, advertising, image caching, an RSS tab, and AR page scanning via the Catchoom/Scanarius SDK, and ships in multiple publisher flavours (Huethig, LOFT, Unternehmerzeitung). It migrated UIWebView to WKWebView over its lifetime.

items.title: Boehringer
items.description: Boehringer is a Unity mobile-VR application built for Boehringer (pharmaceuticals) using the Google VR SDK (Cardboard/Daydream-style). It pairs the GoogleVR Unity SDK with a Modern UI Pack and ~205 C# scripts of own experience logic. Two commits (asset import).

items.title: MedTriX-Lobby
items.description: MedTriX-Lobby is a Laravel (PHP) web application with Blade/Vue views serving as the entry 'lobby' for the MedTriX medical platform. It presents branded, clickable logo/partner arrangements and document (PDF) content. The project is small and early-stage (5 commits, one contributor) on a standard Laravel skeleton.

items.title: WattweiserAvatar
items.description: WattweiserAvatar is a Unity application that renders an interactive talking 'avatar' (for the 'Wattweiser' energy/advisory context). It streams and records avatar video with natural turning animations, a record button, sounds and baked lightmaps (Bakery), and ships with a small web front-end wrapper. It is a focused, single-author project (6 commits).

items.title: eventure-dash
items.description: eventure-dash is the operations/management dashboard for the Eventure platform, built on ASP.NET Core with a Blazor WebAssembly client. It manages live Eventure deployments and 3D 'interactables', performs server setup (announcing interactables from client config), provisions and controls remote machines via SSH/SFTP and DigitalOcean (RemoteMachineService), handles world presets and store/subdomain access checks, archives events and resets statistics, and manages identity clients/policies for the publisher and Unity clients. Real-time updates use SignalR.

items.title: Amberg
items.description: Amberg is a Unity SteamVR application (a room-scale VR experience, likely for the Amberg site/client). It builds on Valve's SteamVR Unity plugin for controller input and interaction, with ~226 C# scripts of own logic on top. It is a single-commit project import.

items.title: MultiplayerKitForHVR
items.description: MultiplayerKitForHVR is a Unity multiplayer add-on for HurricaneVR (HVR), adding networked VR interaction on top of the HurricaneVR physics-hands framework. It provides networked rigidbodies (ExtendedNetworkRigidBody), networked socketing of objects, synchronized hand/finger poses, and networked interactive props (e.g. a lock with sound and animations). It uses ParrelSync for in-editor multiplayer testing and represents genuine, iterative engineering (31 commits).

items.title: ObjectRecognitionPOC
items.description: ObjectRecognitionPOC is a Unity proof-of-concept for in-app object detection/recognition. It pairs Unity (C# + Shapes vector graphics, UWP target) with native C/C++ detection code (ObjectDetectorImages) to recognize objects from images. Git LFS stores the model/binary assets. It is an early POC (5 commits).

items.title: UnityShelfPOC
items.description: UnityShelfPOC is a Unity proof-of-concept for retail-shelf scenarios — placing and stocking products on shelves, posing a camera, and generating shelf photos (with raytracing and automation). It appears aimed at producing synthetic shelf imagery / product-placement scenes, using the Shapes vector library and mesh-combine optimization (12 commits).

items.title: octo
items.description: octo (OctoAG) is an ASP.NET Core web application with an Angular SPA frontend that provides software licensing and product-management services. It includes a Magalone licensing service, Pimero sync, product/license registration and usage-marking APIs, account management (create users via API), and a scheduled 'holidays updater' task. Authentication uses cookie/JWT with client-side route guards, and the Angular frontend supports server-side rendering (Angular Universal).

items.title: eventure-server
items.description: eventure-server is the backend platform behind the Eventure/eventerspace virtual world. Built on ASP.NET Core with a Blazor WebAssembly management dashboard, it provides identity/authentication (IdentityServer-style schemes with role-based redirects), real-time room and presence management integrated with Photon (thread-safe RoomInfo repositories and Photon jobs), client/asset configuration delivery, a chat system (channels, message management) with an integrated ChatGPT 'fake user', a multi-instance vector-DB layer, and PDF/document processing.

items.title: VNSAssets
items.description: VNSAssets is the Unity 3D content repository for 'Virtual Networking Suites' (VNS) — the exhibition stands, expo buildings, furniture and props used in the VNS virtual event spaces. It is organized as multiple asset projects (base/internal/expo assets) producing Photon-aware asset bundles, with interactables (sittable chairs, exhibit displays) and WebGL/standalone builds. It saw sustained content work (176 commits, 7 contributors).

items.title: LabelStudioTemplates
items.description: LabelStudioTemplates is a customized fork of **Label Studio** (the open-source data-labeling platform by HeartexLabs) holding labeling-interface templates and configuration. The bulk of the code is the upstream Label Studio project (Python backend + React/JS editor frontend); 's own contribution is a thin layer of labeling templates and tweaks, as reflected by the small and largely generic commit history. Because it is mostly third-party OSS, its original-IP value is low.

items.title: ShelfTrainer
items.description: ShelfTrainer is a C/C++ object-detection training/inference project for retail-shelf recognition, built on the Darknet/YOLO (v4/v7) neural-network framework. The repository is predominantly the third-party Darknet/YOLO codebase plus build artifacts and CUDA tooling; 's own contribution is configuration/integration. Original-IP value is low.

items.title: VNSWebClient
items.description: VNSWebClient is the Unity WebGL client for 'Virtual Networking Suites' (VNS) — a 3D virtual networking/event space comparable to eventure. Users join shared 3D scenes as avatars with real-time multiplayer (Photon) and in-world video conferencing via the Amazon Chime SDK. It includes a custom networking/event-delegate layer, scene changing, interactables, an asset loader with recursive dependency resolution, and player nameplates; a companion VNS_SDK provides shared building blocks.

items.title: IAmFroggerVR
items.description: IAmFroggerVR is a Unity cross-platform VR game (a Frogger-style experience). It builds on the Oculus Integration (including cross-platform Oculus Avatars usable on non-Oculus devices) and SteamVR/OpenVR for headset support. It is a single-commit import; most content is the Oculus SDK plus ~898 C# scripts of own game logic.

items.title: heynote-web
items.description: heynote-web is the backend and management web platform of **Heynote**, a multi-tenant SaaS that lets field/service employees track the work they do for customers. It combines an ASP.NET Core Web API, a Blazor WebAssembly admin/management client, and a separate Vue 3 frontend; the mobile data-entry apps (heynote-mobile / heynote-ios) consume the same API. The backend follows a CQRS architecture (MediatR) over EF Core + ASP.NET Identity for multi-tenant data and authentication (JWT, WebAuthn, Apple login, invited-user activation), with FluentValidation, Mapster mapping and Refit typed clients. It is the most production-mature repo in the portfolio (CI/CD + xUnit tests).

items.title: eventure
items.description: eventure (a.k.a. 'eventerspace') is a Unity-based 3D virtual event and networking space delivered to the browser via WebGL. Users join shared 3D scenes as avatars, move around, interact with in-world 'interactables' (info points, scene changes, objects), chat and use voice. A JavaScript web layer (ClientWeb) wraps the Unity WebGL build and implements an action system (notifications, prompts, scene change/teleport, open-URL, speech, sound, player kick), native bridging via Vuplex 3D WebView, and CDN-based asset streaming; real-time multiplayer is provided through Photon. It is the largest and most mature codebase in the portfolio.

items.title: EventerspaceChalet
items.description: EventerspaceChalet is a branded 'Eventerspace' virtual-venue experience: a Unity 3D scene (with avatars, e.g. a female avatar) combined with a PHP web layer ('WebStuff', including Magalone content and an AWS SDK for PHP integration). It is a hybrid 3D + web deliverable for a specific chalet/venue. PHP file count and LoC are inflated by the bundled AWS SDK.

items.title: iAsthma
items.description: iAsthma is a 2019 Unity augmented-reality educational application about asthma, targeting Windows (UWP) and using Vuforia (QCAR) for marker-based AR and LeanTween for animation. It is a substantial codebase (~1434 C# files) imported in only two commits; the large reported LoC includes bundled asset-store packages.

items.title: pimero
items.description: pimero is a large, mature commercial groupware / personal-information-management (PIM) product written in C#/.NET (Windows desktop + web service). It includes calendar/contacts collaboration, an email module, an activity feed, a web service, guided help (WPF), standard/QV modules and UI controls, backed by a Firebird database. Despite only two commits, this is a long-lived, substantial codebase — the git history is shallow because it was migrated into Git from an older VCS, not because it is new or generated.

items.title: Magalone
items.description: Magalone is a JavaScript/HTML/CSS engine for building and presenting interactive digital magazines/publications (part of 's 'Maglify' family). It includes a custom render pipeline, touch/click handling, sound, and a documentation/demo set, spanning 2016-2022. Its large reported LoC is inflated by bundled _trash/publish/demo and vendored assets, so original-code volume is much smaller.

items.title: XolairBowQuest
items.description: XolairBowQuest is a Unity VR experience for Xolair (a pharmaceutical brand) themed around a bow/archery 'quest'. It uses AVPro Video for 360-degree/stereo video playback (inside-sphere, fog/alpha variants) and custom pulse shaders. Single-commit import; reported LoC (~347k) is inflated by bundled assets ('Y_XolairRipped').

items.title: MaglifyDesigner
items.description: MaglifyDesigner is a Windows desktop authoring tool (C#/.NET WinForms with DevExpress) for creating interactive digital magazines/publications in the 'Maglify' product family, here in a Schwabe-branded build. It bundles companion tools (license creation, HTML5 publishing, charts) and a PHP upload backend, and publishes content for the Maglify readers. Reported LoC is heavily inflated by bundled jQuery-UI/DataTables demo assets.

items.title: VR_Quest_Kugelschreiber
items.description: VR_Quest_Kugelschreiber is a 2019 Oculus Quest VR experience (a branded 'Kugelschreiber'/ballpoint-pen quest). It demonstrates the Oculus In-App-Purchase API and skill-based matchmaking around an online multiplayer board-game sample, with networking, a discovery/lobby scene, a lab scene and a fill-amount shader. Reported LoC (~523k) is dominated by bundled asset-store/Oculus packages.

items.title: BallPen_Carandache
items.description: BallPen_Carandache is a Unity product-visualization application for Caran d'Ache (the Swiss writing-instruments manufacturer), presenting a ballpoint pen in high fidelity with custom uber/volumetric-light shaders and LOD/mesh-combine optimization. Its very large reported LoC (~527k) is dominated by bundled asset-store packages, not original code. Two commits (asset import).

items.title: DungeonQuest
items.description: DungeonQuest is a Unity 3D game/experience (dungeon-crawler theme) using Burst/Unity.Mathematics and UMotion animation, with custom environment-blend tessellation shaders. The reported source LoC (~8.7 million) is a counting artifact from bundled assets/generated HTML and must not be read as hand-written code; original C# is ~508 files. Single-commit import.
